summary: Scoped a focused follow-on research task on identifying, reaching, and pitching FellowScript to small-group leaders/pastors specifically, building on two prior FellowScript research runs (marketing channels/positioning, and gatekeeper/leader-first outreach) without re-deriving their already-settled conclusions. Plan targets the specific tactical gap both prior runs flagged as unresolved: concrete identification mechanics, concrete reach channels, concrete pitch/messaging content, and named unfilled gaps (cold-outreach script/template, ministry-coordinator pitch angle) for this persona specifically.
